name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a defined purpose, with protections for both disclosing and receiving parties.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, to be completed and signed by both parties alongside the standard terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Comprehensive agreement governing the provision of cloud-based software services, covering access rights, payment, privacy, security, indemnification, and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partners to use a product in development, provide feedback, and participate in a design program in exchange for shaping the product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Defines uptime and response time targets for a cloud service, along with service credits and remedies when targets are not met.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement for the provision of professional services, covering deliverables, intellectual property ownership, payment, confidentiality, and indemnification.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant agreement governing how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including data transfer mechanisms and security obligations.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Flexible agreement for business partnerships, covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, confidentiality, and indemnification.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement governing the licensing of on-premise or installable software, covering usage rights, restrictions, updates, payment, and warranty.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement allowing a customer to evaluate a product during a defined pilot period before committing to a long-term agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement governing how a service provider (business associate) handles protected health information on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to an existing agreement governing the use of AI and machine learning services, covering model training restrictions, input/output ownership, and AI-specific disclaimers.
